retrievalProfile.description: A multi-panel grid of high-contrast, desaturated portraits featuring heavy CRT scanline textures and digital noise.

recipe.visualDefinition: A 3x3 or irregular grid of close-up portraits characterized by extreme contrast, heavy digital grain, and horizontal scanlines that mimic an old television monitor. The imagery is primarily desaturated with occasional warm or cool tinting, emphasizing texture over clarity.
coreVisualRelationships: Repetition of subject across multiple panels
Uniform application of horizontal scanline texture
High-contrast lighting creating deep shadows and blown-out highlights
Tight, claustrophobic framing of the human face and hands
coreInvariants: Visible horizontal CRT scanline pattern across all panels
Heavy digital noise and grain texture
High-contrast tonal range with crushed blacks

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Multiple close-up views of a single subject, varying in scale from extreme close-up to medium shots, distributed across a grid.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central panel or the panel with the highest contrast serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves erratically across the grid, jumping between high-contrast facial features and textured shadows.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with visual information and texture.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated greys and off-whites providing the base tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks used for heavy shadows and panel borders.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Subtle sepia or blue tints appearing in specific panels to break total monochrome.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with extreme value contrast between highlights and shadows.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single utilitarian sans-serif for functional labeling.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed feel for small metadata blocks.
Offers a clean, industrial look that fits the lo-fi aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a 3x3 grid of high-contrast, monochrome portraits with a heavy CRT scanline and digital noise filter applied globally.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a small, white, condensed sans-serif text block in the bottom right corner, styled as a standard parental advisory or metadata tag.

verificationChecks: Are the scanlines visible and consistent?
Is the contrast high enough to crush shadow detail?
Is the grid layout clearly defined?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Subject] with [3x3 Grid Layout] + [CRT Scanline Filter] + [High Contrast Monochrome] + [Digital Noise].
